This man, who championed the repeal of the Crittenden-Johnson Resolution, owned property at Caledonia that was attacked by Jubal Early in 1863, leading to the destruction of his iron works. He worked with John Bingham, Charles Sumner and other congressmen in 1868 to impeach Andrew Johnson for opposing the Reconstruction Acts, which he had a major role in drafting. For 10 points, name this Pennsylvania representative and leader of the Radical Republicans.
